boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 77 packs a 5×7 grid with an orange '12' block on the left, a blue '2' block on the right, and directional arrow blocks on the edges. The orange '12' needs 12 exits — clear the bottom first, then work the numbered blocks, and finish with the heavy '12' block.
landmarks: Block Out Level 77 packs a 5×7 grid with an orange '12' block on the left, a blue '2' block on the right, and directional arrow blocks on the edges.
The orange '12' needs 12 exits — clear the bottom first, then work the numbered blocks, and finish with the heavy '12' block.
The board mixes Orange, Blue, Red and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: The '12' block is a marathon — clear the lighter '2' block first to build space.
Clear the bottom first to give the numbered blocks sliding room.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Clear the purple and blue blocks at the bottom through the bottom exit to open the base.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Shift the green blocks on the left out through the left exit to open the lower-left area.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Begin clearing the blue '2' block on the right through the right exit — it is the lighter target.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Work the orange '12' block on the left through the left exit as the middle opens.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Clear the red blocks on the top through the right exit.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish with any remaining blocks trapped in the corners.

failurePoints: Trying to clear the '12' block before the '2' block — the '12' block needs room to slide and exit multiple times.
Clearing the top before the bottom, which leaves the lower blocks trapped with no sliding room.
